title: Kinetic Poster
style: Type only, full bleed. A saturated signal-orange ground, near-black type set huge and tight, outline letters that fill solid as they land, an italic word for emphasis, a marquee of repeating rows, and hard colour-flash title cards (blue, black, paper). Motion blur on fast moves.
learnsFrom: Kinetic-type reels made with code: big words as the whole picture, outline-to-fill reveals, marquee rows, colour-flash cards cut on the beat.

story.what: hook: 'FIND' slams in from the left, letters overshooting into place, a thin rule draws under it
'ONE' drops in as outline letters that fill solid one by one; 'HOUR.' follows in italic, the full stop in the accent blue
the three words shear and stack into a tight block; the block scales past the frame, leaving only the full stop
a marquee: five rows of 'NO MORE BACK AND FORTH' scroll in alternating directions, outline and solid rows interleaved
colour-flash cards on each beat: blue 'ASK', black 'MATCH', paper 'BOOK', each word landing with a squash
all three words fly into a line 'ASK · MATCH · BOOK.' that settles; a counter ticks 12 → 1 beside it
sign-off: 'Oriel.' in the huge type on the orange, 'find a time that works for everyone' in small italic under it

sizes: Vertical stacks the words one per line at a larger size and runs the marquee rows taller.
sound: beatScore drive at 120 bpm: a hit on every slam and colour card, whooshes into the stack and the marquee, the sign-off under the name.
teaches: Type can be the whole picture: size, weight, outline and colour changes carry the story, and every change lands on a beat.

portable.style: Type only, full bleed. A saturated orange ground, near-black type set huge and tight, outline letters that fill solid as they land, an italic word for emphasis, a marquee of repeating rows moving in alternating directions, and hard colour-flash title cards (blue, black, paper) cut on the beat. Add motion blur on fast moves by averaging several draws inside the shutter.
portable.sound: a driving loop at 120 bpm with a hit on every slam and colour card, rising noise into the stack and the marquee, and a short sign-off under the name.
